SUBJECTIVE

Cough improving; mild pleuritic pain on deep breath.

OBJECTIVE

T 37.4 °C, BP 128/76, HR 88, SpO2 95% on 2 L.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN

1. Community-acquired pneumonia, improving. Continue ceftriaxone, day 3 of 5.

2. AKI, Cr 1.4 from 1.1. Hold lisinopril; repeat BMP in the morning.

postRound.noteText:
SNF FOLLOW-UP

SUBJECTIVE

Hip pain 3/10, working with PT twice daily.

OBJECTIVE

BP 118/70, HR 72, afebrile. Incision clean and dry.

ASSESSMENT

1. Left hip fracture s/p ORIF, progressing with therapy.

2. Constipation, resolved on senna.

PLAN

1. Continue PT/OT twice daily, weight bearing as tolerated.

2. Continue senna 8.6 mg nightly.

3. Family meeting Friday about discharge home.
